import itertools
import json

# Adjective categories, with vocabulary taken from the givens and options.
vocabulary = {
    "opinion": "silly terrible wonderful lovely repulsive ridiculous mysterious nice awful good",
    "size": "medium-size massive little huge large tiny big small enormous midsize normal-size",
    "age": "new archaic old-fashioned ancient old brand-new",
    "shape": "prismlike rectangular pyramidal circular square triangular spherical",
    "color": "yellow violet aqua crimson brown green maroon magenta cyan pink blue indigo red gray black white",
    "origin": "egyptian chinese turkish vietnamese german bangladeshi mexican russian iranian ethiopian filipino thai indonesian",
    "material": "plastic wood wool iron fiberglass cardboard glass leather paper cloth",
    "purpose": "typing whittling exercise walking smoking hiking car snorkeling drinking driving eating",
}
category = {
    word: group
    for group, words in vocabulary.items()
    for word in words.split()
}

givens = """
yellow ruler
silly violet fork
silly aqua key
prismlike sunglasses
new ruler
archaic apple
terrible stapler
crimson dog
medium-size spoon
old-fashioned hammer
prismlike pen
typing ruler
new guitar
plastic egyptian necklace
wonderful shoe
whittling ruler
lovely piano
new scissors
whittling saw
lovely aqua necklace
massive spoon
ancient exercise candle
silly brown jar
rectangular stapler
prismlike bird
walking car
wood chinese hat
smoking apple
little square plate
old-fashioned typing flower pot
repulsive canvas
hiking hat
wool speaker
turkish old green box
huge dog
pyramidal lamp
prismlike saw
circular flower pot
maroon chair
egyptian jar
magenta bird
hiking spoon
iron sofa
large hat
tiny speaker
fiberglass vietnamese bottle
cyan hat
old-fashioned car key
new smoking toolbox
big triangular earring
terrible hat
maroon piano
ridiculous indigo sunglasses
archaic snorkeling bicycle
cardboard sofa
lovely fork
circular bowl
pink guitar
medium-size car
large fork
blue candle
triangular plate
rectangular spoon
huge scissors
massive knife
small circular pencil
small spherical key
ancient drinking candle
new drill
new drinking bowl
triangular sunglasses
brand-new cup
mysterious hammer
enormous triangular calculator
whittling stapler
square bed
cardboard typing lovely flower pot
german piano
glass bangladeshi watch
wool hammer
triangular house
iron mexican vase
massive rectangular screwdriver
prismlike necklace
nice red flower pot
old-fashioned pen
awful magenta spoon
russian bird
crimson flower pot
tiny pyramidal vase
good key
leather iranian box
repulsive gray ring
ethiopian knife
brown bag
midsize circular chair
snorkeling trash can
new whittling fire extinguisher
""".strip().splitlines()

options = {
    "A": "circular large old-fashioned driving good black sofa",
    "B": "wood filipino ancient smoking awful violet tiny prismlike fork",
    "C": "prismlike brand-new smoking ridiculous violet iranian paper bed",
    "D": "old drinking terrible white normal-size square wrench",
    "E": "cloth thai brand-new eating good blue plate",
    "F": "fiberglass indonesian brand-new smoking wonderful cyan massive bottle",
    "G": "big rectangular archaic smoking terrible yellow vase",
    "H": "thai old drinking nice green massive pyramidal clock",
    "I": "glass bangladeshi old-fashioned snorkeling nice magenta prismlike canvas",
    "J": "spherical little ancient walking good indigo bangladeshi jar",
}

def adjective_sequence(sentence):
    result = []
    for word in sentence.split():
        if word not in category:
            break
        result.append(category[word])
    return result

def precedence_pairs(sequence):
    return {
        (sequence[i], sequence[j])
        for i in range(len(sequence))
        for j in range(i + 1, len(sequence))
        if sequence[i] != sequence[j]
    }

constraints = set()
for sentence in givens:
    constraints.update(precedence_pairs(adjective_sequence(sentence)))

# Exhaustively enumerate every category order compatible with the givens.
compatible_orders = []
for order in itertools.permutations(vocabulary):
    position = {group: i for i, group in enumerate(order)}
    if all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in constraints):
        compatible_orders.append(position)

if not compatible_orders:
    print(json.dumps({
        "final_answer": "UNSUPPORTED",
        "evidence": {"reason": "The givens admit no category ordering."}
    }, separators=(",", ":")))
else:
    counts = {}
    for label, sentence in options.items():
        pairs = precedence_pairs(adjective_sequence(sentence))
        counts[label] = sum(
            all(position[a] < position[b] for a, b in pairs)
            for position in compatible_orders
        )

    answer = "".join(label for label in options if counts[label] > 0) or "K"
    print(json.dumps({
        "final_answer": answer,
        "evidence": {
            "compatible_category_orders": len(compatible_orders),
            "option_compatible_orders": counts,
            "inferred_precedence": [
                [a, b] for a, b in sorted(constraints)
            ]
        }
    }, separators=(",", ":")))
